statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances
The service is to guide further management of the patient's recurrent syncope and presyncope
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on care being covered by another payer under Coordination of Benefits protocols
Meridian Health is the secondary payer
